monograph.title: The Gravitic Altars: The Architecture of Gravitational Stratigraphy
monograph.core_thesis: Localized gravitational fields shaped through non-Euclidean mass-tensor arrays provide essential structural tension and inertial stability across outer choir vaults.
axioms: Gravitic flux operates as a load-bearing tension vector within non-Euclidean architecture.
Tensors of mass distribution stabilize chambers against gravitational shear.
Gravitational curvature metrics are permanently archived as stratigraphic layers within the Ash Archive.
